title: Validation Record
description: Canonical record for npm registry validation of a dependency candidate.

validation_id.description: Unique identifier for this validation event.

dependency_record_id.description: Reference to the extracted dependency record being validated.

registry.description: Registry name, such as npm or a compatible registry mirror.

registry_query_url.description: The exact registry query URL used when checking the dependency.

http_status.description: HTTP status code returned by the registry request, if available.

registry_exists.description: Whether the package was found to exist in the registry at validation time.

namespace_available.description: Whether the namespace or package scope is reported as currently available or not occupied, when relevant.

validation_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp for the validation event in ISO-8601 UTC format.

validation_status.description: Outcome of the validation attempt, such as success, not_found, network_error, excluded, or ambiguous.

classification.description: Final classification assigned after applying the study's classification procedure.

manual_review_required.description: Whether the record requires human review before final classification is accepted.

manual_review_reason.description: Reason a record was flagged for manual review, if applicable.

evidence.description: List of evidence entries supporting the validation outcome, such as registry response snippets or exclusion reasons.

validator_version.description: Version string of the validation logic or script used to check the dependency.
